channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Martin County brush fires contained, but Florida Forest Service warns more expected this summer
item.description:
Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike. Both fires are now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service. Officials say the conditions that fuel these fires are not going away anytime soon, but residents should not be alarmed.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb to panoramic views
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, offers visitors a 105-step climb to panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.

item.title: Port St. Lucie soccer stadium groundbreaking set for November, new renderings show 6,000-seat venue
TCCEED doubles employer participation in second year of paid summer internship program
item.description: TCCEED placed 61 Treasure Coast students in paid summer internships this year, doubling employer participation and tripling student applications from the first year of the program.

item.title: Port St. Lucie ranks 67th most stressed city in US, financial stress cited as key factor
item.description: Port St. Lucie was ranked the 67th most stressed city in the United States and 42nd most financially stressed according to a WalletHub study released this month.

item.title: Karolina Muchova Ends Coco Gauff's Wimbledon Run in Dramatic Tiebreaker
item.description: Karolina Muchova defeated Coco Gauff 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) on Thursday in a match that ended with a drama-filled tiebreaker, becoming the fourth Czech woman in the last six years to reach the Wimbledon final.

item.title: Linda Noskova Wins Wimbledon Women's Title After Saving Five Match Points
item.description: The 21-year-old Czech player recovered from a second-set meltdown in which she wasted five match points to overcome Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 in an all-Czech final on Saturday.

item.title: St. Lucie Mets Snap Three-Game Skid With 4-1 Win Over Jupiter
item.description:
The St. Lucie Mets snapped a three-game losing streak Saturday evening with a wire-to-wire 4-1 win over the Jupiter Hammerheads at Roger Dean Chevrolet Stadium.
